title: WebViSE: Scaling Visual Design Intelligence from the Open Web for LLM Website Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33929v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have made remarkable strides in website development, enabling complete and interactive web experiences to be built from natural-language instructions with far less effort. Yet, non-expert users often struggle to articulate sophisticated visual and interaction designs in natural language. Meanwhile, the open web already contains a vast reservoir of such design knowledge, embodied in mature website implementations. To this end, we introduce Website-derived Visual Skill Extraction (WebViSE), a framework that automatically abstracts these implementations into reusable Visual Skills and builds a structured Skill library. To scale the library, WebViSE organizes its Skills in a multi-parent DAG and jointly evolves Skill descriptions and DAG structure using Skill-conditioned Potential Queries, enabling efficient matching between diverse user instructions and relevant Skills. translated_title: WebViSE：从开放网络扩展视觉设计智能以助力大语言模型网站生成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在网站开发领域已取得显著进展，能够以更少的精力从自然语言指令构建完整且可交互的网页体验。然而，非专业用户往往难以用自然语言准确表达复杂的视觉与交互设计。与此同时，开放网络中已蕴含着海量此类设计知识，具体体现在成熟的网站实现之中。为此，我们提出了“网站衍生视觉技能提取”框架WebViSE，它能够自动将这些网站实现抽象为可复用的“视觉技能”，并构建一个结构化的技能库。为了扩展技能库，WebViSE以多父节点有向无环图（DAG）的形式组织技能，并利用“技能条件化的潜在查询”联合演化技能描述与DAG结构，从而实现多样化用户指令与相关技能之间的高效匹配。自动演化的结构优于非层级的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出WebViSE框架，自动将开放网络中成熟网站的实现抽象为可复用的视觉技能，并通过多父节点DAG组织与联合演化技能库，使大语言模型能够根据自然语言指令生成具有专业视觉与交互设计的网站。
en_tdlr: WebViSE automatically distills mature open-web website implementations into reusable Visual Skills organized in an evolving multi-parent DAG, enabling LLMs to generate visually sophisticated websites from natural-language instructions.
